### Payload
`POST /webhook/lead-capture` with header `X-Eki-Webhook-Secret`.
`{ "name": "...", "phone": "2348012345678", "email": "..", "source": "landing", "user_type": "vendor|buyer", "consent": true }`
A welcome WhatsApp template is only sent when `consent` is true, the phone is valid, and `WA_TPL_WELCOME_D1` is configured (EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY: Meta template approval).
